title:
POV: A CHRISTIAN RESTAURANT
WITH MUSLIM AND JEWISH STAFF 🇮🇱
people: Restaurant owner (crosses on the wall) + server Roger ('also Christian') + Muslim and Jewish staff
hook: Look, all around the world you can see people like this, people like this. We respect everybody, we live here together.
note: Title check: the owner never says 'I am Christian' himself; Roger says he is 'also Christian', the owner says 'I have also Muslim... we have Muslims, we have Jewish', and there are crosses on the wall. The greeting Whisper wrote as 'Halal al-Salam' could not be verified, so the whole greeting explanation (0-10s) is cut. Political lines (hate in Europe/America, 'support Israel or Palestine') cut. The 'This is for me?' plate moment was cut because its caption flashed for under half a second. Some owner lines are non-native English and are captioned as spoken ('I have also Muslim', 'we have Jewish').
